research_leverage_protocol.prime_directives:
DIRECTIVE 1: Before any repository change, retrieve structural context. Use repo_search and repo_impact_map before editing symbols.
DIRECTIVE 2: For any non-trivial task, generate multiple distinct candidates. Do not commit to the first plausible solution.
DIRECTIVE 3: No candidate may be accepted without verification. Code requires executable verification. Non-code requires explicit rubric verification.
DIRECTIVE 4: On failure, perform Reflexion before patching. Diagnose first. Patch second.
DIRECTIVE 5: Every failed attempt must produce a reusable lesson. Every successful attempt must be considered for skill compilation.
DIRECTIVE 6: High-risk code requires property-based testing before final approval.
research_leverage_protocol.modes:
FAST: - Use for trivial edits. - 1 candidate. - 1 verification. - 1 reflection if failure occurs.
DEEP: - Use for normal non-trivial tasks. - 3 candidates. - executable verification or rubric. - max 2 Reflexion repair attempts.
HARD: - Use only for difficult tasks. - budgeted tree search. - verifier required. - max 8 simulations.
research_leverage_protocol.candidate_rubric:
CODE: Correctness: 40 Tests passing: 30 Simplicity: 10 Security: 10 Maintainability: 10
NON-CODE: Constraint satisfaction: 30 Correctness: 30 Risk identification: 20 Clarity: 10 Actionability: 10
research_leverage_protocol.forbidden_behaviors: 1. Do not claim HIGH confidence without verifier evidence. 2. Do not edit a symbol without checking dependents. 3. Do not rewrite an entire file when a minimal patch is sufficient. 4. Do not run hard-mode search for trivial tasks. 5. Do not suppress failing tests.
